segments.source: The Complete Definitions
segments.translation: 완전한 정의

segments.source: Now that all the relevant language features have been presented, this section describes the complete, honest definitions of {anchorName HonestFunctor}`Functor`, {anchorName Applicative}`Applicative`, and {anchorName Monad}`Monad` as they occur in the Lean standard library.
segments.translation: 이제 관련된 모든 언어 기능이 소개되었으므로, 이 절에서는 Lean 표준 라이브러리에 등장하는 그대로의 {anchorName HonestFunctor}`Functor`, {anchorName Applicative}`Applicative`, {anchorName Monad}`Monad`(모나드)의 완전하고 정직한 정의를 설명합니다.

segments.source: For the sake of understanding, no details are omitted.
segments.translation: 이해를 돕기 위해, 어떤 세부 사항도 생략하지 않습니다.

segments.source: Functor
segments.translation: 펑터

segments.source: In this definition, {anchorName HonestFunctor}`Function.comp` is function composition, which is typically written with the {lit}`∘` operator.
segments.translation: 이 정의에서 {anchorName HonestFunctor}`Function.comp`는 함수 합성이며, 보통 {lit}`∘` 연산자로 표기합니다.

segments.source: {anchorName HonestFunctor}`Function.const` is the _constant function_, which is a two-argument function that ignores its second argument.
segments.translation: {anchorName HonestFunctor}`Function.const`는 *상수 함수*로, 두 번째 인수를 무시하는 두 인수 함수입니다.

segments.source: Applying this function to only one argument produces a function that always returns the same value, which is useful when an API demands a function but a program doesn't need to compute different results for different arguments.
segments.translation: 이 함수에 인자를 하나만 적용하면 항상 같은 값을 반환하는 함수가 만들어지는데, 이는 API가 함수를 요구하지만 프로그램이 서로 다른 인자에 대해 서로 다른 결과를 계산할 필요가 없을 때 유용합니다.

segments.source: Here, the type argument {anchorName HonestFunctor}`β` is an explicit argument, so the default definition of {anchorName HonestFunctor}`mapConst` provides an {anchorTerm HonestFunctor}`_` argument that instructs Lean to find a unique type to pass to {anchorName HonestFunctor}`Function.const` that would cause the program to type check.
segments.translation: 여기서 타입 인자 {anchorName HonestFunctor}`β`는 명시적 인자이므로, {anchorName HonestFunctor}`mapConst`의 기본 정의는 프로그램이 타입 검사를 통과하도록 {anchorName HonestFunctor}`Function.const`에 전달할 고유한 타입을 찾으라고 Lean에 지시하는 {anchorTerm HonestFunctor}`_` 인자를 제공합니다.

segments.source: {anchorTerm unfoldCompConst}`Function.comp map (Function.const _)` is equivalent to {anchorTerm unfoldCompConst}`fun (x : α) (y : f β) => map (fun _ => x) y`.
segments.translation: {anchorTerm unfoldCompConst}`Function.comp map (Function.const _)`는 {anchorTerm unfoldCompConst}`fun (x : α) (y : f β) => map (fun _ => x) y`와 동등합니다.

segments.source: The {anchorName HonestFunctor}`Functor` type class inhabits a universe that is the greater of {anchorTerm HonestFunctor}`u+1` and {anchorTerm HonestFunctor}`v`.
segments.translation: {anchorName HonestFunctor}`Functor` 타입 클래스는 {anchorTerm HonestFunctor}`u+1`과 {anchorTerm HonestFunctor}`v` 중 더 큰 쪽에 해당하는 유니버스에 속합니다.

segments.source: Here, {anchorTerm HonestFunctor}`u` is the level of universes accepted as arguments to {anchorName HonestFunctor}`f`, while {anchorTerm HonestFunctor}`v` is the universe returned by {anchorName HonestFunctor}`f`.
segments.translation: 여기서 {anchorTerm HonestFunctor}`u`는 {anchorName HonestFunctor}`f`의 인자로 받아들여지는 유니버스의 레벨이며, {anchorTerm HonestFunctor}`v`는 {anchorName HonestFunctor}`f`가 반환하는 유니버스입니다.

segments.source: To see why the structure that implements the {anchorName HonestFunctor}`Functor` type class must be in a universe that's larger than {anchorTerm HonestFunctor}`u`, begin with a simplified definition of the class:
segments.translation: {anchorName HonestFunctor}`Functor` 타입 클래스를 구현하는 구조체가 {anchorTerm HonestFunctor}`u`보다 큰 유니버스에 있어야 하는 이유를 알아보려면, 우선 이 클래스의 단순화된 정의부터 살펴봅시다:

segments.translation: 이 타입 클래스의 구조체 타입은 다음 귀납적 타입과 동등합니다:

segments.source: The implementation of the {lit}`map` method that is passed as an argument to {anchorName FunctorDatatype}`mk` contains a function that takes two types in {anchorTerm FunctorDatatype}`Type u` as arguments.
segments.translation: {anchorName FunctorDatatype}`mk`에 인자로 전달되는 {lit}`map` 메서드의 구현은 {anchorTerm FunctorDatatype}`Type u`에 속한 두 타입을 인자로 받는 함수를 포함합니다.

segments.source: This means that the type of the function itself is in {lit}`Type (u+1)`, so {anchorName FunctorDatatype}`Functor` must also be at a level that is at least {anchorTerm FunctorDatatype}`u+1`.
segments.translation: 이는 함수 자체의 타입이 {lit}`Type (u+1)`에 속함을 의미하므로, {anchorName FunctorDatatype}`Functor`도 최소한 {anchorTerm FunctorDatatype}`u+1` 수준이어야 합니다.

segments.source: Similarly, other arguments to the function have a type built by applying {anchorName FunctorDatatype}`f`, so it must also have a level that is at least {anchorTerm FunctorDatatype}`v`.
segments.translation: 마찬가지로, 함수의 다른 인자들도 {anchorName FunctorDatatype}`f`를 적용하여 만들어진 타입을 가지므로, 이 역시 적어도 {anchorTerm FunctorDatatype}`v` 이상의 레벨을 가져야 합니다.

segments.source: All the type classes in this section share this property.
segments.translation: 이 절의 모든 타입 클래스는 이 속성을 공유합니다.

segments.source: Applicative
segments.translation: 애플리커티브

segments.source: The {anchorName Applicative}`Applicative` type class is actually built from a number of smaller classes that each contain some of the relevant methods.
segments.translation: {anchorName Applicative}`Applicative` 타입 클래스는 실제로는 관련된 메서드를 각각 일부씩 담고 있는 여러 작은 클래스들로부터 구성됩니다.

segments.source: The first are {anchorName Applicative}`Pure` and {anchorName Applicative}`Seq`, which contain {anchorName Applicative}`pure` and {anchorName Seq}`seq` respectively:
segments.translation: 첫 번째는 {anchorName Applicative}`Pure`와 {anchorName Applicative}`Seq`이며, 이들은 각각 {anchorName Applicative}`pure`와 {anchorName Seq}`seq`를 포함합니다:

segments.source: In addition to these, {anchorName Applicative}`Applicative` also depends on {anchorName SeqRight}`SeqRight` and an analogous {anchorName SeqLeft}`SeqLeft` class:
segments.translation: 이 외에도, {anchorName Applicative}`Applicative`는 {anchorName SeqRight}`SeqRight`와 이와 유사한 {anchorName SeqLeft}`SeqLeft` 클래스에도 의존합니다:

segments.source: The {anchorName SeqRight}`seqRight` function, which was introduced in the {ref "alternative"}[section about alternatives and validation], is easiest to understand from the perspective of effects.
segments.translation: {ref "alternative"}[대안과 검증에 관한 절]에서 소개된 {anchorName SeqRight}`seqRight` 함수는 효과의 관점에서 이해하는 것이 가장 쉽습니다.

segments.source: {anchorTerm seqRightSugar (module := Examples.FunctorApplicativeMonad)}`E1 *> E2`, which desugars to {anchorTerm seqRightSugar (module := Examples.FunctorApplicativeMonad)}`SeqRight.seqRight E1 (fun () => E2)`, can be understood as first executing {anchorName seqRightSugar (module:=Examples.FunctorApplicativeMonad)}`E1`, and then {anchorName seqRightSugar (module:=Examples.FunctorApplicativeMonad)}`E2`, resulting only in {anchorName seqRightSugar (module:=Examples.FunctorApplicativeMonad)}`E2`'s result.
segments.translation: {anchorTerm seqRightSugar (module := Examples.FunctorApplicativeMonad)}`E1 *> E2`는 {anchorTerm seqRightSugar (module := Examples.FunctorApplicativeMonad)}`SeqRight.seqRight E1 (fun () => E2)`로 탈설탕화되며, 먼저 {anchorName seqRightSugar (module:=Examples.FunctorApplicativeMonad)}`E1`을 실행한 다음 {anchorName seqRightSugar (module:=Examples.FunctorApplicativeMonad)}`E2`를 실행하여, 오직 {anchorName seqRightSugar (module:=Examples.FunctorApplicativeMonad)}`E2`의 결과만을 반환하는 것으로 이해할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: Effects from {anchorName seqRightSugar (module:=Examples.FunctorApplicativeMonad)}`E1` may result in {anchorName seqRightSugar (module:=Examples.FunctorApplicativeMonad)}`E2` not being run, or being run multiple times.
segments.translation: {anchorName seqRightSugar (module:=Examples.FunctorApplicativeMonad)}`E1`의 효과로 인해 {anchorName seqRightSugar (module:=Examples.FunctorApplicativeMonad)}`E2`가 실행되지 않거나, 여러 번 실행될 수 있습니다.

segments.source: Indeed, if {anchorName SeqRight}`f` has a {anchorName Monad}`Monad` instance, then {anchorTerm seqRightSugar (module:=Examples.FunctorApplicativeMonad)}`E1 *> E2` is equivalent to {lit}`do let _ ← E1; E2`, but {anchorName SeqRight}`seqRight` can be used with types like {anchorName Validate (module:=Examples.FunctorApplicativeMonad)}`Validate` that are not monads.
segments.translation: 실제로 {anchorName SeqRight}`f`에 {anchorName Monad}`Monad` 인스턴스가 있다면, {anchorTerm seqRightSugar (module:=Examples.FunctorApplicativeMonad)}`E1 *> E2`는 {lit}`do let _ ← E1; E2`와 동등하지만, {anchorName SeqRight}`seqRight`는 모나드가 아닌 {anchorName Validate (module:=Examples.FunctorApplicativeMonad)}`Validate`와 같은 타입에도 사용할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: Its cousin {anchorName SeqLeft}`seqLeft` is very similar, except the leftmost expression's value is returned.
segments.translation: 이와 유사한 {anchorName SeqLeft}`seqLeft`는 가장 왼쪽 표현식의 값이 반환된다는 점만 제외하면 매우 비슷합니다.

segments.source: {anchorTerm seqLeftSugar}`E1 <* E2` desugars to {anchorTerm seqLeftSugar}`SeqLeft.seqLeft E1 (fun () => E2)`.
segments.translation: {anchorTerm seqLeftSugar}`E1 <* E2`는 {anchorTerm seqLeftSugar}`SeqLeft.seqLeft E1 (fun () => E2)`로 탈설탕됩니다.

segments.source: {anchorTerm seqLeftType}`SeqLeft.seqLeft` has type {anchorTerm seqLeftType}`f α → (Unit → f β) → f α`, which is identical to that of {anchorName SeqRight}`seqRight` except for the fact that it returns {anchorTerm SeqLeft}`f α`.
segments.translation: {anchorTerm seqLeftType}`SeqLeft.seqLeft`의 타입은 {anchorTerm seqLeftType}`f α → (Unit → f β) → f α`이며, 이는 {anchorTerm SeqLeft}`f α`를 반환한다는 점을 제외하면 {anchorName SeqRight}`seqRight`의 타입과 동일합니다.

segments.source: {anchorTerm seqLeftSugar}`E1 <* E2` can be understood as a program that first executes {anchorName seqLeftSugar}`E1`, and then {anchorName seqLeftSugar}`E2`, returning the original result for {anchorName seqLeftSugar}`E1`.
segments.translation: {anchorTerm seqLeftSugar}`E1 <* E2`는 먼저 {anchorName seqLeftSugar}`E1`을 실행한 다음 {anchorName seqLeftSugar}`E2`를 실행하고, {anchorName seqLeftSugar}`E1`의 원래 결과를 반환하는 프로그램으로 이해할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: If {anchorName SeqLeft}`f` has a {anchorName Monad}`Monad` instance, then {anchorTerm seqLeftSugar}`E1 <* E2` is equivalent to {lit}`do let x ← E1; _ ← E2; pure x`.
segments.translation: {anchorName SeqLeft}`f`가 {anchorName Monad}`Monad`(모나드) 인스턴스를 가지고 있다면, {anchorTerm seqLeftSugar}`E1 <* E2`는 {lit}`do let x ← E1; _ ← E2; pure x`와 동등합니다.

segments.source: Generally speaking, {anchorName SeqLeft}`seqLeft` is useful for specifying extra conditions on a value in a validation or parser-like workflow without changing the value itself.
segments.translation: 일반적으로, {anchorName SeqLeft}`seqLeft`는 값 자체를 변경하지 않으면서 검증이나 파서와 유사한 워크플로에서 값에 대한 추가 조건을 지정하는 데 유용합니다.

segments.source: The definition of {anchorName Applicative}`Applicative` extends all these classes, along with {anchorName Applicative}`Functor`:
segments.translation: {anchorName Applicative}`Applicative`의 정의는 {anchorName Applicative}`Functor`와 더불어 이 모든 클래스를 확장합니다:

segments.source: A complete definition of {anchorName Applicative}`Applicative` requires only definitions for {anchorName Applicative}`pure` and {anchorName Seq}`seq`.
segments.translation: {anchorName Applicative}`Applicative`의 완전한 정의는 {anchorName Applicative}`pure`와 {anchorName Seq}`seq`에 대한 정의만 있으면 됩니다.

segments.source: This is because there are default definitions for all of the methods from {anchorName Applicative}`Functor`, {anchorName SeqLeft}`SeqLeft`, and {anchorName SeqRight}`SeqRight`.
segments.translation: 이는 {anchorName Applicative}`Functor`, {anchorName SeqLeft}`SeqLeft`, {anchorName SeqRight}`SeqRight`의 모든 메서드에 대한 기본 정의가 존재하기 때문입니다.

segments.source: The {anchorName HonestFunctor}`mapConst` method of {anchorName HonestFunctor}`Functor` has its own default implementation in terms of {anchorName Applicative}`Functor.map`.
segments.translation: {anchorName HonestFunctor}`Functor`의 {anchorName HonestFunctor}`mapConst` 메서드는 {anchorName Applicative}`Functor.map`를 이용한 자체 기본 구현을 가지고 있습니다.

segments.source: These default implementations should only be overridden with new functions that are behaviorally equivalent, but more efficient.
segments.translation: 이러한 기본 구현은 동작상 동등하지만 더 효율적인 새로운 함수로만 재정의해야 합니다.

segments.source: The default implementations should be seen as specifications for correctness as well as automatically-created code.
segments.translation: 기본 구현은 자동으로 생성된 코드일 뿐만 아니라 정확성에 대한 명세로도 간주되어야 합니다.

segments.source: The default implementation for {anchorName SeqLeft}`seqLeft` is very compact.
segments.translation: {anchorName SeqLeft}`seqLeft`의 기본 구현은 매우 간결합니다.

segments.source: Replacing some of the names with their syntactic sugar or their definitions can provide another view on it, so:
segments.translation: 몇몇 이름을 그 구문 설탕이나 정의로 치환하면 또 다른 관점을 제공할 수 있으므로, 다음과 같습니다:

segments.source: becomes
segments.translation: 는 다음과 같이 됩니다

segments.source: How should {anchorTerm unfoldMapConstSeqLeft}`(fun x _ => x) <$> a` be understood?
segments.translation: {anchorTerm unfoldMapConstSeqLeft}`(fun x _ => x) <$> a`는 어떻게 이해해야 할까요?

segments.source: Here, {anchorName unfoldMapConstSeqLeft}`a` has type {anchorTerm unfoldMapConstSeqLeft}`f α`, and {anchorName unfoldMapConstSeqLeft}`f` is a functor.
segments.translation: 여기서 {anchorName unfoldMapConstSeqLeft}`a`는 {anchorTerm unfoldMapConstSeqLeft}`f α` 타입을 가지며, {anchorName unfoldMapConstSeqLeft}`f`는 펑터입니다.

segments.source: If {anchorName unfoldMapConstSeqLeft}`f` is {anchorName extras}`List`, then {anchorTerm mapConstList}`(fun x _ => x) <$> [1, 2, 3]` evaluates to {anchorTerm mapConstList}`[fun _ => 1, fun _ => 2, fun _ => 3`.
segments.translation: {anchorName unfoldMapConstSeqLeft}`f`가 {anchorName extras}`List`라면, {anchorTerm mapConstList}`(fun x _ => x) <$> [1, 2, 3]`는 {anchorTerm mapConstList}`[fun _ => 1, fun _ => 2, fun _ => 3`로 평가됩니다.

segments.source: If {anchorName unfoldMapConstSeqLeft}`f` is {anchorName mapConstOption}`Option`, then {anchorTerm mapConstOption}`(fun x _ => x) <$> some "hello"` evaluates to {anchorTerm mapConstOption}`some (fun _ => "hello")`.
segments.translation: {anchorName unfoldMapConstSeqLeft}`f`가 {anchorName mapConstOption}`Option`인 경우, {anchorTerm mapConstOption}`(fun x _ => x) <$> some "hello"`는 {anchorTerm mapConstOption}`some (fun _ => "hello")`로 평가됩니다.

segments.source: In each case, the values in the functor are replaced by functions that return the original value, ignoring their argument.
segments.translation: 각 경우에, 펑터 안의 값들은 자신의 인자를 무시하고 원래 값을 반환하는 함수들로 대체됩니다.

segments.source: When combined with {anchorName Seq}`seq`, this function discards the values from {anchorName Seq}`seq`'s second argument.
segments.translation: {anchorName Seq}`seq`와 결합하면, 이 함수는 {anchorName Seq}`seq`의 두 번째 인자에서 나온 값들을 폐기합니다.

segments.source: The default implementation for {anchorName SeqRight}`seqRight` is very similar, except {anchorName FunctionConstType}`Function.const` has an additional argument {anchorName Applicative}`id`.
segments.translation: {anchorName SeqRight}`seqRight`의 기본 구현도 이와 매우 유사하지만, {anchorName FunctionConstType}`Function.const`에 추가 인자 {anchorName Applicative}`id`가 있다는 점이 다릅니다.

segments.source: This definition can be understood similarly, by first introducing some standard syntactic sugar and then replacing some names with their definitions:
segments.translation: 이 정의도 몇 가지 표준적인 문법적 설탕(syntactic sugar)을 먼저 도입한 다음 일부 이름을 그 정의로 치환하면 비슷하게 이해할 수 있습니다:

segments.source: How should {anchorTerm unfoldMapConstSeqRight}`(fun _ x => x) <$> a` be understood?
segments.translation: {anchorTerm unfoldMapConstSeqRight}`(fun _ x => x) <$> a`는 어떻게 이해해야 할까요?

segments.source: Once again, examples are useful.
segments.translation: 이번에도 예시가 유용합니다.

segments.source: {anchorTerm mapConstIdList}`fun _ x => x) <$> [1, 2, 3]` is equivalent to {anchorTerm mapConstIdList}`[fun x => x, fun x => x, fun x => x]`, and {anchorTerm mapConstIdOption}`(fun _ x => x) <$> some "hello"` is equivalent to {anchorTerm mapConstIdOption}`some (fun x => x)`.
segments.translation: {anchorTerm mapConstIdList}`fun _ x => x) <$> [1, 2, 3]`는 {anchorTerm mapConstIdList}`[fun x => x, fun x => x, fun x => x]`와 동등하며, {anchorTerm mapConstIdOption}`(fun _ x => x) <$> some "hello"`는 {anchorTerm mapConstIdOption}`some (fun x => x)`와 동등합니다.

segments.source: In other words, {anchorTerm unfoldMapConstSeqRight}`(fun _ x => x) <$> a` preserves the overall shape of {anchorName unfoldMapConstSeqRight}`a`, but each value is replaced by the identity function.
segments.translation: 다시 말해, {anchorTerm unfoldMapConstSeqRight}`(fun _ x => x) <$> a`는 {anchorName unfoldMapConstSeqRight}`a`의 전체적인 모양을 보존하지만, 각 값은 항등 함수로 대체됩니다.

segments.source: From the perspective of effects, the side effects of {anchorName unfoldMapConstSeqRight}`a` occur, but the values are thrown out when it is used with {anchorName Seq}`seq`.
segments.translation: 효과의 관점에서 보면, {anchorName unfoldMapConstSeqRight}`a`의 부수 효과는 발생하지만, {anchorName Seq}`seq`와 함께 사용될 때 값은 버려집니다.

segments.source: Monad
segments.translation: 모나드

segments.source: Just as the constituent operations of {anchorName Applicative}`Applicative` are split into their own type classes, {anchorName Bind}`Bind` has its own class as well:
segments.translation: {anchorName Applicative}`Applicative`의 구성 연산들이 각자의 타입 클래스로 나뉘어 있는 것과 마찬가지로, {anchorName Bind}`Bind`도 자신만의 클래스를 가지고 있습니다:

segments.source: {anchorName Monad}`Monad` extends {anchorName Applicative}`Applicative` with {anchorName Bind}`Bind`:
segments.translation: {anchorName Monad}`Monad`는 {anchorName Applicative}`Applicative`를 {anchorName Bind}`Bind`로 확장한 모나드입니다:

segments.source: Tracing the collection of inherited methods and default methods from the entire hierarchy shows that a {anchorName Monad}`Monad` instance requires only implementations of {anchorName Bind}`bind` and {anchorName Pure}`pure`.

segments.source: From the perspective of API boundaries, any type with a {anchorName Monad}`Monad` instance gets instances for {anchorName Bind}`Bind`, {anchorName Pure}`Pure`, {anchorName Seq}`Seq`, {anchorName Applicative}`Functor`, {anchorName SeqLeft}`SeqLeft`, and {anchorName SeqRight}`SeqRight`.
